questions.explanation: Nominalization turns 'introduce' into the noun 'introduction'.
questions.q: The ___ of the new system took months.

questions.explanation: The formal collocation is 'conduct an investigation'.
Formal style prefers the nominalization: 'made a decision to postpone'.
options: They decided to postpone the meeting.
They did a decision to postpone the meeting.
They made a decision to postpone the meeting.
They took a decision for postponing the meeting.

questions.explanation: Nominalization turns 'fail' into the noun 'failure'.
questions.q: The ___ to meet the deadline surprised everyone.

questions.explanation: The formal verb is 'submit your request'.
The nominalized noun is 'conclusion'.
Formal style prefers 'due to' over 'because of'.
questions.q: The flight was cancelled ___ the storm.

questions.explanation: The formal verb is 'received your complaint'.
Nominalization turns 'examine' into 'examination'.
questions.q: The ___ of the evidence took hours.

questions.explanation: Formal style prefers the single precise verb 'investigate'.
options: We will look into the matter.
We will look the matter into.
We will make a look into the matter.

questions.explanation: Formal style prefers 'Regarding the delay'.
questions.q: ___ the delay, we offer our apologies.

questions.explanation: Nominalization turns 'reduce' into the noun 'reduction'.
The formal collocation is 'meet the criteria'.
Nominalization turns 'plan' into the noun 'planning'.
'Put off' is informal; formal style uses 'postponed'.
options: Further details are available on request.
questions.q: Find the sentence that is too informal.

questions.explanation: Nominalization turns 'construct' into 'construction'.
Formal correspondence uses 'We look forward to your reply'.
Formal style prefers 'Due to the new regulations'.
questions.q: ___ to the new regulations, masks are required.

questions.explanation: Formal style uses 'obtained the position' and 'due to + noun phrase'.
options: He got the job because he was good.
He got the job due to he was good.
He obtained the position because of he was qualified.
He obtained the position due to his qualifications.

questions.explanation: Nominalization turns the verb into the noun 'implementation'.
questions.q: The ___ of the proposal is under review.
